notes.en: Qualified the 1.1.1 package with its frozen managed engine artifact through the actual App capture-loop native run: the real Linux/riscv64 guest under iPadOS 27 Simulator passed 1 of 1 tests with no failures or skips (about 3,354 seconds). The small page returned 34 elements with 301 needs, facts and second-round findings; the raw engine's default 120-second deadline returned a typed timeout for the 6,007-element page. With that deadline explicitly disabled on the same input, round one requested 350 points, native facts answered all 350, and round two returned inconclusive. The cancellation gate passed with the guest responsive. The embedded runtime descriptor binds the exact frozen artifact bytes and capture contract. Coverage is partial with no clean certification, and large-page computation is slow in the simulated guest. This is guest plus Simulator native qualification, not physical-device or Apple-published-build acceptance. Admitted on the iOS channel only; Android offers are unchanged. No paid model call was made.
notes.zh-Hans: 1.1.1包已连同其冻结的受管引擎产物，通过真实App采集环原生运行完成鉴定：iPadOS 27模拟器下的真实Linux/riscv64客体通过1/1项测试，无失败与跳过（约3,354秒）。小页面返回34个元素、301项需求、事实与第二轮发现；6007元素的大页面在原始引擎CLI的默认120秒预算下如实返回超时；同一输入显式关闭时间预算后，第一轮请求350个检查点，原生事实全部匹配，第二轮返回inconclusive。取消检查通过，客体保持响应。内嵌运行时描述符绑定确切冻结产物与采集契约。覆盖仍为部分且不出具“全部通过”结论，大页面计算在模拟客体中确实缓慢。此为客体加模拟器的原生鉴定，不是真机或Apple发布构建验收。仅按iOS渠道准入；Android供给不变。无付费模型调用。
